chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Gus Wilson, the Ritz in Buffalo and Peanuts
summary: Gus Wilson, the second trombone, was found in Buffalo; the Ritz became the Valet Royal and union trouble recurred.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Where did you get Gus Wilson, was he the first guy to become a second trombone?
We got Gus Wilson in Buffalo.
Oh, when you were playing the Chez Paris?
We played the Valet Royal. (Phonetic spelling)
Valet Royal; why do I keep saying Chez Paris.
You see, we went to Buffalo twice. We played the Ritz Ballroom in Buffalo, which later became the Valet Royal.
It was the Ritz while you were playing there?
It was the Ritz while we were there and then we went to Canada, came
back and it was the Valet Royal.
Was it the second time that the union gave you all the problems?
Then it was called the Valet Royal.
Right. That's when we got Peanuts too.
